High quality electrical work and solar installations engineered for durability, safety, and efficiency.

article.p: Full property wiring, new main line supply, and power point planning for residential and commercial setups.
Safe, concealed house wiring executed with high-grade copper cables and structured distribution boxes.
Fast fault diagnosis, short circuit resolution, line testing, and replacement of faulty fixtures.
Protection against electrical shocks, line overloads, and earth leakage with branded MCBs and RCCBs.
Modern architectural LED lighting, decorative lighting layouts, shopfront LEDs, and floodlights.
Turnkey rooftop solar power plant setup with structural mounting, panels, and grid connectivity.
Power backup system sizing, tubular battery installation, and automatic inverter changeover wiring.
Routine inspection, solar panel cleaning guidance, panel tightening, and preventive maintenance.

div.h2:

WORK FOR YOU.
div.p: Reduce electricity costs and secure uninterrupted power with custom rooftop solar installations designed specifically for your energy consumption.
Clean Energy Generation
Evaluation of roof area, shadow analysis, and load calculations.
Custom design, component selection, and structural layout.
Precision structure mounting, panel fixing, and DC/AC cabling.
Thorough testing of protection devices, voltage levels, and inverter sync.
System handover, operation guidance, and ongoing support.
Explore recent electrical and solar projects completed by SM Traders.
BUILT BY PEOPLE WHO KNOW THE WORK.

div.p: Clean conduit routing, labelled distribution boards, and precise terminations that stand the test of time.
We strictly use ISI-certified wires, branded switchgear, and durable mounting structures.
Comprehensive earthing, surge protection, and circuit isolation to safeguard lives and appliances.
Upfront estimations, transparent scope of work, and no hidden charges.
Hands-on engineering for rooftop solar generation and smooth grid integration.
Prompt resolution of queries, maintenance visits, and reliable post-installation backing.
High quality electrical components supplied and installed for your projects.
